description: Create or update a standing agent — a saved {goal + tickers + schedule} that fires either a fixed step recipe (agent_type="workflow", free/deterministic) or an AI-directed team (agent_type="autonomous", charged — settles against the owner's BYO key first, falling back to the managed wallet only if funded). Upsert semantics: omit `agent_id` to CREATE a new agent; pass an existing `agent_id` to UPDATE it. There is no separate update_agent — this does both, matching save_watchlist/save_thesis's house style. `agent_type` is STRUCTURAL and immutable: always required, and on an update it is verified against the existing agent before anything is changed — passing a different agent_type than the agent already has is rejected (delete and recreate to change the type). `steps` (an array of {kind:"tool"|"sop", name, args, label?}) is required and non-empty when CREATING an agent_type="workflow" agent, and must be omitted for agent_type="autonomous" (use `managed_model` there instead, itself optional and only valid for agent_type="autonomous"). `when` picks the trigger: "manual" (fires only via run_agent or the Workspace UI) or "schedule" (requires a `schedule` object — cadence "weekly" needs day_of_week, "monthly" needs day_of_month). This tool does NOT itself fire a run — use run_agent for that. Tier: sp500+ (sample rejected).

agent_id.description: Omit to create a new agent; pass an existing agent's id (from save_agent/list_agents/get_agent) to update it.

agent_type.description: STRUCTURAL and immutable. "workflow" = fixed step recipe, free/deterministic, requires `steps`. "autonomous" = AI-directed team, charged, may set `managed_model`.

goal.description: What this agent is trying to accomplish — drives an autonomous agent's AI-directed team, and documents intent for a workflow agent's fixed steps.

managed_model.description: Managed-lane model override for agent_type="autonomous" only (e.g. when no BYO key is connected). Omit to use the account default.

day_of_month.description: 1-28 (clamped to avoid short-month skips). Required when cadence="monthly".

minute.description: UTC minute to fire at (0-59, default 0).

timezone.description: IANA timezone (e.g. "America/New_York") for display only — hour_utc/minute above are authoritative and always UTC.

steps.description: Fixed step recipe for agent_type="workflow". Required + non-empty when CREATING a workflow agent; must be omitted for agent_type="autonomous".

args.description: Arguments for this step. Supports {{ticker}} substitution the same way run_workflow's plan does.

kind.description: Whether `name` names an MCP tool or a SOP (playbook) slug.

label.description: Optional human-readable label for this step.

tickers.description: US tickers this agent operates over. Normalised to uppercase.

when.description: Trigger mode. "manual" fires only via run_agent/the UI; "schedule" requires the `schedule` object.

name: save_agent

_meta.description: Provenance envelope — data lineage for every MCP response

cost_usd.description: Per-call cost transparency. Omitted for subscription-only and free tools, which have no MPP price.

basis.description: mpp_charge = real pay-per-call charge (a card or MPP payment through agent-pay). mpp_rate_card = indicative price, not billed.

billed.description: true = this amount was actually charged via MPP for this call. false = indicative MPP-equivalent value only: no charge was made for this call (it was within your plan).

data_plan.description: Access plan: sample | sp500 | pro | full

data_quality.description: Server-side invariants run on this response

fundamentals_as_of.description: ISO timestamp when the FINANCIAL STATEMENTS were last rebuilt in bulk. Use THIS — not `last_updated` — when telling a user how current the cross-sectional fundamentals are. The snapshot is republished on every weekday price refresh while the statements are carried forward unchanged, so `last_updated` can be far more recent than the numbers it sits next to. It is a floor for a single filer, not a ceiling: a filer with a live partition receives its filing, facts and ratios intraday (minutes after EDGAR dissemination), so an entity-scoped read may carry a filing newer than this; cross-sectional ranks (factor scores, earnings signals) refresh with the weekly bulk export.

last_updated.description: ISO timestamp when the snapshot was exported

latency_ms.description: Wall-clock milliseconds this tool call took, measured server-side around the handler.

limit_warnings.description: Soft-warning array for partial fulfillment. Each entry carries a stable subcode + remediation.options[]. AI agents pattern-match on subcode.

mpp_offer.description: Present when figures still need payment: the MPP option (price, resource_url, request body) for the full run.

mpp_override.description: Set when this single response was paid for over MPP (card, agent-pay): the payment's order was honoured for this call only. agent-pay captures the payment only when this is present.

mpp_verification.description: Verification tools only, when some figures are outside the caller's plan. Figures the plan covers are always verified free; a Valuein account also verifies its first figures free, once, figures outside its plan included (the verification trial, size in pricing://current). served_free = own-plan figures plus trial figures; trial_used / trial_remaining = this run's draw and what the account has left; needs_payment = figures still to pay for (the paid verification run). A guest has no trial: note says how to get it.

pit_safe.description: true iff a zero-look-ahead point-in-time cut was applied to every returned figure

reset_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the window resets

truncation.description: Set when fewer rows were returned than requested — explains why and points to a remedy

title: Save Agent
